'''Zooki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He worked for [[Gambo]], a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] enforcer. Zooki met all of Gambo's visitors in the [[Dealer's Den]], and warned a traveling hero that he shouldn't try to arrest Gambo. The hero did it anyway, either convincing Gambo to leave or knocking him out.<ref name="TOR" />
